'''Nar Kasuen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Residing on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], Kasuen managed a small shop, he taught the knowledge of [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]] construction to others.
